mapper.select: SELECT 'board' AS board_type, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CL_BOARD WHERE STATUS = 'Y') AS total_cnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CL_BOARD WHERE STATUS = 'N') AS hidden_cnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CL_BOARD_REPLY WHERE STATUS = 'Y') AS comment_cnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CL_BOARD_LIKE) AS like_cnt FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT 'activity' AS board_type, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CL_ACTIVITY_BOARD WHERE STATUS = 'Y') AS total_cnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CL_ACTIVITY_BOARD WHERE STATUS = 'N') AS hidden_cnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CL_ACTIVITY_REPLY WHERE STATUS = 'Y') AS comment_cnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CL_ACTIVITY_LIKE) AS like_cnt FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT 'campaign' AS board_type, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CL_CAMPAIGN WHERE STATUS = 'Y') AS total_cnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CL_CAMPAIGN WHERE STATUS = 'N') AS hidden_cnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CL_CAMPAIGN_REPLY WHERE STATUS = 'Y') AS comment_cnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CL_CAMPAIGN_LIKE) AS like_cnt FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT 'notice' AS board_type, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CL_NOTICE WHERE STATUS = 'Y') AS total_cnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CL_NOTICE WHERE STATUS = 'N') AS hidden_cnt, NULL AS comment_cnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CL_NOTICE_ATTACHMENT) AS like_cnt FROM DUAL

SELECT r.REGION_NO AS regionNo, r.REGION_NAME AS regionName, NVL(board.boardCount, 0) AS boardCount, NVL(activity.activityCount, 0) AS activityCount, NVL(board.boardCount, 0) + NVL(activity.activityCount, 0) AS totalCount FROM CL_REGION_CATEGORY r LEFT JOIN ( SELECT REGION_NO, COUNT(*) AS boardCount FROM CL_BOARD WHERE STATUS = 'Y' GROUP BY REGION_NO ) board ON r.REGION_NO = board.REGION_NO LEFT JOIN ( SELECT REGION_NO, COUNT(*) AS activityCount FROM CL_ACTIVITY_BOARD WHERE STATUS = 'Y' GROUP BY REGION_NO ) activity ON r.REGION_NO = activity.REGION_NO ORDER BY totalCount DESC

SELECT r.REGION_NO AS regionNo, r.REGION_NAME AS regionName, SUM(t.count) AS totalCount FROM ( SELECT REGION_NO, COUNT(*) AS count FROM CL_BOARD WHERE STATUS = 'Y' GROUP BY REGION_NO UNION ALL SELECT REGION_NO, COUNT(*) AS count FROM CL_ACTIVITY_BOARD WHERE STATUS = 'Y' GROUP BY REGION_NO ) t JOIN CL_REGION_CATEGORY r ON t.REGION_NO = r.REGION_NO GROUP BY r.REGION_NO, r.REGION_NAME ORDER BY totalCount DESC

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT BOARD_TITLE AS title, VIEW_COUNT AS views, 'board' AS boardType FROM CL_BOARD WHERE STATUS = 'Y' UNION ALL SELECT ACTIVITY_TITLE AS title, VIEW_COUNT AS views, 'activity' AS boardType FROM CL_ACTIVITY_BOARD WHERE STATUS = 'Y' UNION ALL SELECT CAMPAIGN_TITLE AS title, VIEW_COUNT AS views, 'campaign' AS boardType FROM CL_CAMPAIGN WHERE STATUS = 'Y' UNION ALL SELECT NOTICE_TITLE AS title, VIEW_COUNT AS views, 'notice' AS boardType FROM CL_NOTICE WHERE STATUS = 'Y' ) t ORDER BY views DESC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY
